title: Gloves of Heroism

sources.title: Warding Hands
markers: | description = When you use your [[Channel Oath Charge]] spells, you gain {{Cond|Heroism}}.

summary: Gain +1 Strength saves. Use a Channel Oath ability to gain Heroism for 10 turns.

fields.Heroism: You cannot become Frightened and receive 5 temporary HP each turn. Subclass spells that are always prepared are not Channel Oath abilities.
fields.Base value: 110 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
